origin.description: The joint Wald table that print.anova.rq displays.
origin.details: The joint Wald table that print.anova.rq displays.
origin.example:
fit <- rq(y ~ x1 + x2, data=df, tau=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
a <- anova(fit, se="nid", joint=TRUE)
c(a$table$ndf, a$table$ddf, a$table$Tn, a$table$pvalue)
